Tires warm (> 150 F) most of the run
probes.hint: keep driving — tires still cold for most frames

advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 18/38 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 16.88; 8/8 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts lock first: brake balance 2-4% rearward.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.20 vs R 0.09; 7/23 stops

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 184 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.72) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 23 stops (3 both-axle, 7 front-first, 4 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
